scope: A read-only operator preflight for an explicit Studio/proxy pair. Host-filesystem behavior has local fixtures; actual Linux proxy metadata, CLI/example and restart recovery are verified. Personal VM source identity is not certified.
implementation: Added reusable verify_proxy_layout in the framework and nexus studio-host-check CLI, using existing Docker route pinning and explicit context handling.
The inspection format requests IDs, running/privilege flags and mounts only. A fixed isolated Python probe inside the selected immutable proxy ID reads metadata, not ledger bytes.
Added a thin example consumer and extended the existing disposable Linux recovery gate to exercise both real CLI and example paths. No new Docker image, app or installer was built.
verified: Safe host-source fixture passes; private parent/child/direct/read-only exposure, symlink aliases and hard-linked raw socket exposure fail. Actual device/inode ancestry supplements canonical path resolution.

Root proxy, stopped/same containers, privileged Studio, non-dedicated/read-only private mounts, wrong ownership/modes, unsafe ledgers and unavailable/socket access are rejected or explicitly unavailable.

Malformed/oversized/failed/timeout metadata is redacted. Explicit context strips ambient Docker host/TLS routing; exec uses the inspected immutable proxy ID. CLI never prints environment, commands, logs, source paths, exception text or ledger contents.

Six actual POSIX cases verify directory and ledger symlink/mode/link rules and world-writable socket rejection without opening ledger contents. Temporary Unix sockets require runner permission; the successful explicit run used that permission, not a skip.

Actual Linux uid/gid1001 proxy metadata passes nine observable checks through both the CLI and thin example. Host-source checks correctly remain unavailable from this Docker Desktop client, so each live preflight exits1 with passed:false.
Graceful proxy stop exits0; SIGKILL exits137. Both restart cases retain cleanup-only authority and remove the original stopped worker without execution or extra runs.
Temporary Linux controllers/proxies, workers and named volumes are removed; unrelated Docker services are untouched.

A negative fixture reproduced a separate private root plus a nested bind replacing ownership.sqlite incorrectly passing the first draft preflight. The final guard rejects every subordinate private-store mount, including this shared-file exposure.

actual_layout_result.reason: The Mac client cannot resolve the Linux daemon named-volume host sources. Unavailable identity is deliberately not promoted to successful deployment acceptance.

fixture.authority: Only the trusted proxy mounts the raw daemon socket and private ledger. The host operator has existing Docker inspection/exec authority. Controller has neither raw socket nor private ledger.
fixture.host_source_fixtures: Real temporary filesystem paths/inodes with selected metadata supplied by a deterministic test double. Not a real VM mount identity certification.

compatibility.upgrade: Update the source package on the daemon host to gain this optional command. Existing runtime settings and memory-only deployments are unchanged. No activation or automatic repair occurs.
compatibility.rollback: Older versions lack the command but continue reading existing state. No migration or data rollback is needed.
compatibility.report_scope: A successful report is point-in-time mount/stat preflight, not application readiness or full deployment acceptance. An absent ledger is explicitly disclosed and never promoted to live recovery proof.

Personal HTTPS VM login/TLS, bind/mapped ownership, restart/upgrade/full restore and Docker daemon/power-loss checks remain separate.
Escaped MCP descendants, physical voice devices, selected external accounts and native/frozen/installed OS acceptance remain separate.

quality.ruff: All six new/updated framework, example and test modules pass without rule exclusions.

reproduced_before_fix.expected: Failed preflight. This was a draft tool false positive, not a discovered live VM configuration.
